movies.title: Madden
movies.overview: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

movies.title: The First Five Minutes... The Title Design Legacy of Dan Perri
movies.overview: An in-depth exploration into the life of Dan Perri, the man who created titles for some of the most iconic movies of all time.
movies.tagline: Meet the man who made the first five minutes of 300 of your favorite movies.

movies.title: ENE Repeat
movies.overview: Vivek and his gang of friends embark on an attempt to create an ambitious survival film.

movies.title: Dark Noon
movies.overview: Caught in a cycle of petty crime and imprisonment, a man is released from prison for a failed bank robbery attempt while an impending solar eclipse offers a way out of the cycle.

movies.title: Minotaur
movies.overview: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

movies.title: November 1963
movies.overview: Follows the 48 hours after the assassination of President John F. Kennedy, the alleged involvement of Sam Giancana and the 'Chicago Outfit', and a supposed broken promise after the mob helped to get Kennedy elected.
movies.tagline: Betrayed by power. Fuelled by revenge.

movies.title: Josephine
movies.overview: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.
movies.tagline: Too young to understand. Too old to forget.

movies.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
movies.overview: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.
movies.tagline: Welcome to the Second Quarter Quell.

movies.title: Transplant
movies.overview: A motivated surgical resident pushes himself to extreme lengths while training under a legendary heart transplant surgeon who's obsessed with protecting his perfect reputation.

movies.title: The Vile
movies.overview: Devoted wife and mother Amani, whose life begins to unravel when her husband returns home with a second wife and an unseen darkness infiltrates her life.
